device.description: quad 12-bit voltage-output DAC with 12-bit parallel interface, input-register read-back, LDAC and reset to mid scale
device.note: dac7624.pdf (SBAS083) p.1 (description: reset to 800H DAC7624 / 000H DAC7625), p.2 (specifications: VDD 4.75-5.25 V, TTL-compatible logic, straight binary), p.4 (pin configurations and descriptions), p.10 (digital interface, Table I control logic), p.11 (Figure 3, Table II timing, input coding)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A input register (Table I: A1 A0 = 00); RESET loads 800H (mid scale); power-on code not stated (RESET code used)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B input register (Table I: A1 A0 = 01); RESET loads 800H (mid scale); power-on code not stated (RESET code used)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C input register (Table I: A1 A0 = 10); RESET loads 800H (mid scale); power-on code not stated (RESET code used)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D input register (Table I: A1 A0 = 11); RESET loads 800H (mid scale); power-on code not stated (RESET code used)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table I)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table I)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table I)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low (Table I)

commands.name: Write input (CS low, R/W low)
commands.note: Table I: A1 A0 select input register A-D, transparent while CS and R/W are low, latched when CS returns high (p.10)

protocol.note: Table I: CS low with R/W high reads back the input register A1 A0 select on DB11-DB0 (tCSD 160 ns max, tDZ 100 ns typ)

ldac.note: all DAC registers transparent while LDAC is low (p.4, Table I)

reset.note: asynchronous, level: input and DAC registers to 800H (mid scale) while RESET is low (Table I)

pages: p.1 (description: reset to 800H DAC7624 / 000H DAC7625), p.2 (specifications: VDD 4.75-5.25 V, TTL-compatible logic, straight binary), p.4 (pin configurations and descriptions), p.10 (digital interface, Table I control logic), p.11 (Figure 3, Table II timing, input coding)
notModeled: analog: outputs, reference inputs, single (VSS = 0 V) or dual supply operation, settling
power-on state of the registers is not stated in the datasheet (the RESET code is used)
the input registers are level-transparent while CS and R/W are low; the model latches the data at the end of the write
DAC registers are not readable (Table I reads back the input registers only)
variants: DAC7624 (reset to 800H) and DAC7625 (reset to 000H) share dac7624.pdf: same pinout and interface; own spec files. U/UB are linearity grades; the PDIP (P) versions are not in the skeleton.
